fusions.name: Stripped Rows
fusions.desc: Strips every enemy within 2.5 tiles for 3 damage, and you heal for 15% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Swarm Off the Tines
fusions.desc: Flings a knot of the swarm that deals 26 damage to the first enemy it meets and bursts to hit everything within 3.5 tiles for 80% of that.

fusions.name: Cloud Over the Field
fusions.desc: Takes 0.5 seconds to loose a cloud for 12 seconds that bites an enemy within 6 tiles for 3 damage every second.

fusions.name: Nothing Left Standing
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you heal for 15% of the damage you deal for 6 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
